children.text: At the event, BEU Rector Yagub Piriyev noted that state programs implemented by relevant orders of President Ilham Aliyev play an important role in the integration of young people studying abroad into world science and that the strong middle generation that has been formed further increases the intellectual potential of our country. Noting that such meetings are an important platform for strengthening scientific ties and sharing the acquired experience, the rector provided extensive information on BEU's achievements and development directions in recent years. He noted that the university consistently implements an internationalization policy and expands cooperation with international partners. Dual diploma programs with South Korean and Chinese universities are being successfully implemented.

Yagub Piriyev also spoke about the work done at the university towards international accreditation of specialties, the steps taken to expand scientific research, including the more than doubling of the number and geography of foreign students studying at BEU. Also, emphasizing the steps taken to strengthen the academic staff, the rector noted the special importance of cooperation with Azerbaijani scientists working abroad and their experience for teaching and scientific activities in this context.

Chairman of the Board of Directors of DAAB, Doctor of Physical and Mathematical Sciences, Professor Masud Efendiyev emphasized the importance of cooperation between BEU and Azerbaijani scientists living abroad in his speech. He noted that close ties with scientists working in different countries can make a significant contribution to strengthening scientific potential. He highlighted the importance of such meetings in terms of the formation of new projects and increasing knowledge exchange, as well as possible areas of cooperation.

After the speeches of Azerbaijani scientists working in Germany, England, Austria, France, Russia, etc., the involvement of scientists represented in DAAB in the educational process at BEU, the organization of master classes for students, joint research, as well as cooperation with BEU scientific journals were discussed. At the same time, the possibilities of developing cooperation with scientists living abroad in the fields of information technology, economics, biotechnology, chemistry and engineering on a broad scale were considered, and various proposals were put forward.
At the end of the meeting, a preliminary agreement was reached on future cooperation, and coordinators were appointed on both sides to strengthen relations.
